name: Lowered Lashes
text: Whenever you throw off a card, if you bid nil, gain +10 nil value.
timing: When you throw off a card

signature.trigger: you throw off a card while on nil

decision: On a nil, which suit to empty first so later tricks become safe throw-offs that also pay.
opponent: Visible each time it triggers; opponents can lead suits you still hold to deny throw-offs.
aiNote: On a nil, play out your shortest non-spade suit early.
rationale: A nil hand throws off two to four times a round, so a successful nil gains +20 to +40, near Vigil Candle, and it rewards the void-making a nil already wants.
deviation: Simplified from losing a trick while holding a card that could have won it, which was too complicated for a common.
